role: single heuristic priority total; no A/B/C/D or A1/A2
aggregation: base=sum(w*component); loc/chrom/rel missing=0; opportunity null fallback=0.5; coverage=(assessed loc/chrom/rel weights+wO+wT)/sum(weights); score=base*(0.6+0.4*coverage)
localization_branch: nuclear-only main: existing branch; nuclear AND extranuclear main: .55; extranuclear main with nuclear additional: .30; HPA without nuclear support: .10; independent support/cross-reactivity adjustments unchanged
localization_intervals: existing source-reliability heuristic widths propagated separately; not CI
opportunity: O=(2*N+study)/3; study=clip(log1p(Gene_PMIDs)/log(60)); default contribution about 10*N+5*study; count is association, not functional study count; proxy is not exhaustive mechanism review
chromatin_numerator: hub weights of dedicated core edges (specificity_weight==1); broad .25 references excluded from numerator; all observed edges in denominator
representatives: fixed v3 direct-star group membership/anchor; highest current v4.1 score inside group; tie prefers old anchor then symbol; no member removed; no all-pairs equivalence claim
unknown_upper: base plus maximum missing L/E/R weights, hypothetical not statistical CI
